defaultMode.Name: Initiative for new combats
defaultMode.Hint: Individual: everyone rolls and acts in order. Side: the party rolls as usual and the enemies all act on their best static initiative. In round 1 the party members who beat the enemies go first, then the enemies, then the whole party, and the two sides alternate from then on. Each player clicks their portrait when they're done. The GM can switch any combat from the carousel's ⋮ menu.

autoAdvance.Name: Move on when a side is done
autoAdvance.Hint: In side initiative, once everyone acting has clicked done (defeated creatures don't count), the other side's turn starts by itself. Turn off to always move on with the GM's next button.

sideTurnMarkers.Name: Turn markers on the whole acting side
sideTurnMarkers.Hint: In side initiative, every token on the acting side shows Foundry's turn marker until its player clicks done. Turn off to leave turn markers to Foundry, which shows one at a time.

frameImage.Name: Turn frame image
frameImage.Hint: The art around the portrait of whoever is acting. The default is Foundry's orange turn marker.

hpBars.Name: HP bars on portraits
hpBars.Hint: Who sees a hit point bar under each portrait.
hpBars.Owner: The GM and each creature's owners

turnTimer.Name: Turn timer
turnTimer.Hint: Show how long the current turn has taken in the bar under the carousel. In side initiative it times the whole side's turn. It stops while the game is paused, and the GM can click it to start again from zero.

endCombatPrompt.Name: Offer to end combat when the hostiles are down
endCombatPrompt.Hint: Once every hostile creature in a running combat is at 0 HP (or marked defeated), ask the GM whether to end the combat. If you keep fighting, you're asked again only after a hostile gets back up or a new one joins and they all go down again.

autoLairActions.Name: Add lair actions automatically
autoLairActions.Hint: When a creature with lair actions joins combat, add a Lair Action event for it: on its lair action initiative from the dnd5e sheet, or on 20 if it has lair action items but no count. The event leaves with the creature. Turn off to add events yourself from the ⋮ menu.

showCarousel.Name: Show the combat carousel
showCarousel.Hint: Show the turn order across the top of the screen during combat (this browser only).

portraitSize.Name: Carousel portrait size
portraitSize.Hint: Size in pixels of the acting creature's portrait. Everyone else is a little smaller (this browser only).

portraitSource.Name: Carousel portrait image
portraitSource.Hint: Token art matches what you see on the map, which makes it easier to tell creatures apart. Actor portraits use the character art instead (this browser only).

topOffset.Name: Extra space above the carousel
topOffset.Hint: The carousel already sits below dnd5e's calendar and anything else in the top-centre of the screen. Add pixels here if something drawn on top of the screen still overlaps it (this browser only).

Event.Name: Name
Event.CountHint: Individual initiative: it happens on this count and loses ties. Side initiative: just before the enemies' turn if it beats their number, otherwise just after it.
Event.NotesPlaceholder: What happens. Shown in the GM's reminder.
